kebab_example: aliyun pvtz describe-resolver-endpoints --keyword Endpoint-test --lang en --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --status SUCCESS --vpc-region-id cn-zhangjiakou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResolverEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the endpoint name. A fuzzy search is performed
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点名称关键字，使用模糊搜索的方式查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置查询的页码，起始值为 1，默认为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数据量，最大值 100，默认为 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the endpoint. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The endpoint is working as expected.

INIT: The endpoint is being created.

FAILED: The endpoint failed to be created.

CHANGE_INIT: The endpoint is being modified.

CHANGE_FAILED: The endpoint failed to be modified.

EXCEPTION: The endpoint is not working as expected.

If you do not specify this parameter, endpoints in all states are returned. If you specify this parameter, only endpoints in the specified state are returned
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点状态。取值：

SUCCESS: 工作正常。
INIT：创建中。
FAILED：创建失败。
CHANGE_INIT: 修改中。
CHANGE_FAILED: 修改失败。
EXCEPTION: 工作异常。

不传获取全部，传入则获取指定状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the outbound virtual private cloud (VPC) is located
parameters.name: vpc_region_id
